paper text.text:
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction}, with attachments
$a,b,c,d$, the above set $E$, no outside vertices and no
further interior components. Place each attachment at a
branch vertex, inside a branch path or outside the subdivision,
in every possible way and order, and shorten the segments
as in Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision}.
Remove the added edges, join the interior pieces by every
minimal choice of interior edges, and give each attachment
without an interior neighbor one such neighbor in every
possible way. The preceding reduction shows that $B$ occurs
among these candidates. Adjoin two vertices with each of
the neighborhoods $\{a,b,c\}$ and $\{a,b,d\}$ in the first
case, and three and two, respectively, in the second.

The records in~\supp{E9} identify the

vertex names: Psi_2: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with neighbourhood {a,b,d}, as in Section 5. Further vertices with these neighbourhoods are p3, ... and r3, .... Interior vertices of bridges are u0, u1, ...
